title: Flag overdue todos in the web list
probes: A pure presentation change. Exercises the `fe` label and is the one fixture where the visual gate has real work.
description:
As a todo user looking at the web page I want overdue items to stand out so that I notice them without reading every date.

The CLI already appends `[OVERDUE]` to an overdue line (`formatTodo` in the sandbox CLI). The web page shows nothing. Render an overdue marker on the web list using the same rule: not done, and `due` earlier than the local calendar date.

It must stay legible at a narrow phone width, and must not rely on colour alone to convey the state.
